evidence.title: Pieces — The AI memory layer for modern work

name: Pieces
summary: Desktop AI memory layer that captures your work context on-device and serves it to AI tools through an MCP server.
description: Pieces runs in the background on your computer (PiecesOS) and forms a searchable on-device memory: a chronological timeline of what you see, copy and hear across browsers, Slack, email, docs, Figma, meeting apps and IDEs, captured every 2 seconds. The Pieces MCP server carries that context into Cursor, Claude, VS Code, JetBrains and other MCP-ready assistants, and one-click summaries cover standups, briefs and meeting prep. Privacy controls pause capture, exclude apps, or delete by time and source. Pro is per user with a 7-day trial; Enterprise adds governance.
contains: on-device memory captured every 2 seconds from the focused app, clipboard and audio
Pieces MCP server for Cursor, Claude, VS Code, JetBrains and other MCP assistants
sources include Gmail, Outlook, Chrome, Slack, Teams, Zoom, Notion, Figma, ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor, Xcode
timeline view; recall by time, topic, person or tool
one-click standup updates, morning briefs, meeting prep and day recaps
capture controls: pause, per-app disable, delete by time, app or source
